parole.significato: ruin; ruined remains of a destroyed construction, especially of a city, village, house, etc.
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish اورن (ören), from Old Anatolian Turkish اورن (ören), from Proto-Oghuz اُرَنْ (ʾuran /⁠⁠ören⁠/, “bad of everything”), ultimately borrowed from Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (ʾwylʾn' /⁠awērān⁠/). Compare Azerbaijani örən, Persian ویران (virân). Doublet of viran.
